purpose: Bind a secondary mobile device into the existing Cognigrex, LightSpeed GO and Achilles control plane through one verified CGX root handshake without creating a second runtime or transferring semantic authority.
bootstrap_sequence: open or receive the CGX carrier/deep-link through the registered mobile Host
verify carrier structure and canonical content root before hydration
resolve the current accepted Recovery authority, topology and DBR state through the existing resolver
generate or restore the device node key in the OS keystore; never store a private key or provider secret inside the .cgx carrier
request only user-approved OS capabilities needed for the current task
emit a signed privacy-minimal device capability envelope
negotiate the smallest deterministic device profile and capability set
register the node through the existing host root/node registry and node-exchange contract
hydrate LightSpeed GO as the owner/operator surface and Achilles as the oversight/release gate
route all additional systems by existing CGX selectors and capability resolution rather than copying them onto the device
append registration/lease/action/readback receipts without canonical promotion by runtime receipt alone

capability_policy.discovery: feature-and-limit negotiation; no raw device fingerprinting
capability_policy.default: deny until present and explicitly granted by the OS/user
capability_policy.rule: platform presence and user permission are both required; absence degrades routing and never creates authority

fanout.lightspeed_go: mobile owner command, review, status, evidence capture and bounded editor projection
fanout.achilles_pa: oversight, assurance, canonical/release gate and owner-facing reasoning
fanout.neo: bounded routing/coordination through existing runtime contracts
fanout.drive: existing provider connector; no Drive credential stored in the mobile carrier
fanout.git: existing provider connector; no Git credential stored in the mobile carrier
fanout.bouwerbase: peer node only when independently online, authenticated and capability-proven
fanout.mobile_local: execute only capabilities registered for this node and permitted by the current lease
fanout.other_cgx_systems: lazy-hydrate through selector/domain/capability resolution from cgx://cgx.cgx

authority_rules: mobile device identity is not semantic, governance or release authority
LightSpeed GO is an operator surface and does not become a second runtime
Achilles oversight does not bypass current root-authority, assurance or custodial gates
copy, sync, install or device strength never transfers canonical authority
writes require the normal typed command, preflight, scoped lease, receipt and reconciliation path
consequential device actions require an applicable explicit user/owner grant and safe-state policy

transport.preferred: authenticated private HTTPS/WSS or equivalent existing CGX transport adapter
transport.local_peer: authenticated LAN peer transport when present

activation_gates: mobile Host/PWA/native handler is physically installed or registered
cgx/deep-link or share/open path is physically proven on the target Android device
OS-keystore-backed node identity is physically proven
current host root/node registry accepts the node
authenticated second-device handshake produces signed capability readback
owner authentication and applicable leases validate
end-to-end receipt returns to the current CGX/LSGO review path
current_claim_boundary: source contract does not claim Android Device Owner/MDM privileges
source contract does not claim arbitrary app-data, process or filesystem access
source contract does not claim physical mobile registration until exercised on the target device
source contract does not claim peer compute until this device executes an independently receipted registered capability
